name: advocacy-readiness-grader
description: Advocacy Grade — employee-advocacy readiness scored from public evidence: collects robots, sitemaps, sampled pages and the careers surface for any domain and scores it with a deterministic rubric. The report is the product; the letter grade is withheld whenever classification coverage does not earn it.
